endpoints.access: curated_public readable by all tenants; tenant_private isolated to owner (404 on IDOR)
templates:write required, revision 1 created, supports source_template provenance
templates:write required, optimistic base_revision required (409 on stale)
compositions:write + templates:read required, materializes pure Scene Spec 1.0 composition
templates:write + templates:read required, convenience fork of curated or tenant template

template_catalog.sentinel_catalog_protection: Mutating system_catalog curated templates directly (POST /templates/tpl_promo_starter/revisions) is blocked with 404 NOT_FOUND

variable_schema_and_binding_rules.default_resolution_rule: Defaults applied only when variable is absent in request; explicit null is NOT replaced by defaults
variable_schema_and_binding_rules.asset_binding_guards: Asset must exist under tenant RLS scope, be in status ready, and match layer type (image vs video vs svg)

composition_revisions_and_concurrency.optimistic_concurrency: Enforces base_revision === current_revision in atomic transaction; stale revision returns HTTP 409 REVISION_CONFLICT
composition_revisions_and_concurrency.concurrency_race_protection: Concurrent requests with same base_revision yield exactly one 201 Created and subsequent 409 REVISION_CONFLICT

immutable_scene_versions.content_hash_tracking: Computes SHA-256 canonical hash of scene content excluding revision field
immutable_scene_versions.auto_increment_on_edit: When scene content is modified and client kept scene revision low, server automatically increments scene revision (không tin revision client tự giữ thấp)
immutable_scene_versions.unchanged_scene_stability: When scene content is identical across composition revisions, scene revision remains unchanged
database_triggers: trg_template_revisions_no_update blocks direct UPDATE/DELETE on template_revisions
trg_composition_revisions_no_update blocks direct UPDATE/DELETE on composition_revisions
